versions.title: The first build
New: You're an Artificer: build golems and inscribe their cores in code — the Inscription Language drives how each one fights AND how the party delves.
Author named Engrams in the Library, then load them onto golems in the Workshop.
The language grows: spend Insight (earned on a level's first clear) to unlock if / loops / functions / imports and the Mend skill.
Descend into seeded room-graph dungeons — The Ruin and The Vault — with pack fights, loot, buff rooms, hidden rooms and corridor traps.
record(...) writes a golem's own debug lines straight into the delve journal.
Fixes: Level 1 is now beatable from a fresh start: a gentler first boss (the Ruin Keeper), and an end to the level-1 Celerity softlock.
